newsitem.title: USA: USDA declines comment in EEP resumption debate.
newsitem.headline: USDA declines comment in EEP resumption debate.

text.p: U.S. Department of Agriculture officials held back from replying to calls from a senior lawmaker Wednesday for a resumption of Export Enhancement Program (EEP) subsidies.

Foreign Agriculture Service Administrator Gus Schumacher and associate administrator Tim Galvin said they had nothing to add to a statement by Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman, who said Tuesday that he was prepared to use EEP if necessary.
"The secretary has made a very strong statement ... and we stand by that," Schumacher said.
Schumacher and Galvin were speaking to reporters after testifying at a House Agriculture subcommittee hearing.
Earlier Wednesday, House Agriculture Committee Chairman Pat Roberts (R-Kan), said the U.S. administration should make contingency plans for reintroducing EEP to combat new EU grain export subsidies.
